pr_title: fix(core): better handing of ICUs outside of i18n blocks
pr_body:
Currently the logic that handles ICUs located outside of i18n blocks may throw exceptions at runtime. The problem is caused by the fact that we store incorrect TNode index for previous TNode (index that includes HEADER_OFFSET) and do not store a flag whether this TNode is a parent or a sibling node. As a result, the logic that assembles the final output uses incorrect TNodes and in some cases throws exceptions (when incompatible structure is extracted from tView.data due to the incorrect index). This commit adjusts the index and captures whether TNode is a parent to make sure underlying logic manipulates correct TNode.

This PR closes https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/35299.

I do not know, I have not used Ivy in Angular 8. ### Description When loading a certain component with i18n for the first time, Angular produces the error ``` ERROR TypeError: Cannot create property 'next' on number '1' at createTNodeAtIndex (core.js:11541) at getOrCreateTNode (core.js:11499) at createDynamicNodeAtIndex (core.js:34653) at readCreateOpCodes (core.js:34755) at i18nEndFirstPass (core.js:34616) at ɵɵi18nEnd (core.js:34594) at Module.ɵɵi18n (core.js:34961) at BComponent_mat_card_0_Template (b.component.html:14) at executeTemplate (core.js:11841) at renderView (core.js:11627) at TemplateRef.createEmbeddedView (core.js:15157) at ViewContainerRef.createEmbeddedView (core.js:15264) at common.js:4365 at DefaultIterableDiffer.forEachOperation (core.js:27734) at NgForOf._applyChanges (common.js:4353) ``` This error seems to be caused by the template ``` {bar(x), plural, =1 {{{bar(x)}} day} other {{{bar(x)}} days} } ``` But this error is dependent on a lot of circumstances to occur. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction I tried my best to create a minimal reproduction. comments:
You are using the format of i18n without the `i18n` directive, https://angular.io/guide/i18n#pluralization but the compiler still generates i18n code (should create text + interpolation IMHO).
If you place the directive into the `span` tag, the application will work. But the compiler should fix the code.

Hi @PapaNappa, thanks for reporting the issue.

As @tieppt pointed out, the problem was triggered by the ICU ([in this template](https://github.com/PapaNappa/Angular9Bug/blob/master/src/app/a-b/b.component.html#L14)) that was placed outside of the i18n block. I've created a PR (https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/35347) to fix the issue with such ICUs.

Aalso as a possible solution you can create an i18n block explicitly, for example:

```
<ng-container i18n>
  {bar(x), plural, =1 {{{bar(x)}} day} other {{{bar(x)}} days} }
</ng-container>
```

This would work with the current 9.0.0 version (without the changes in the PR that I mentioned).

Thank you.

Hi @PapaNappa, PR #35347 was merged into master and the changes are available in 9.0.2 version of the framework (which is available on NPM). Please upgrade to the 9.0.2 version to get the latest changes. Feel free to reopen this ticket if the problem still exists. Thank you.
